annotations.title: Get domain purchase Coinbase (USDC) pay link

description:
Get a Coinbase checkout link, paid in USDC, to purchase an ALREADY-LISTED Atom marketplace domain. Returns two URLs for the same payment: x402_url — an agent with an x402-capable crypto wallet (e.g. a Coinbase agentic wallet) pays it directly (POST, 402 Payment Required, signed retry); and checkout_url — the hosted page a human opens in a browser to pay with their own wallet. Use this when the user wants to pay with crypto/USDC, or when an x402-capable wallet is available in this session. For a fresh, unlisted domain use get_domain_register_coinbase_pay_link instead.

Always present the exact server-computed price returned here (it includes any registration fee, VAT and the Coinbase processing fee) — never estimate or recompute it yourself. This tool charges nothing by itself.

AFTER PAYMENT: call get_coinbase_payment_status with the returned payment_code to confirm the payment and complete the purchase — the domain is only purchased once that reports status 'completed'. Blockchain confirmation can take a minute; poll again while it reports 'pending'.

If this reports error 'registrant_contact_required', ask the user for their name, phone, address, city, zip, and country, call create_registrant_contact with those, then retry. If it reports 'billing_country_required', the user must save a billing country on their Atom account first.

domain.description: The listed domain to purchase, including extension.

name: get_domain_purchase_coinbase_pay_link

checkout_url.description: Hosted Coinbase checkout page — give this to a human to pay in a browser.

x402_url.description: x402 payment endpoint for agent wallets: POST it, get 402 Payment Required, sign and retry. Prefer this over checkout_url when an x402 wallet is connected.
